http_request_firewall_custom.description: AUDENIQ external requests require HTTPS; reject before origin access

http_response_compression.expression: (http.host in {"audeniq.com" "www.audeniq.com" "studio.audeniq.com" "admin.audeniq.com" "survey.audeniq.com"} and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and http.response.content_type.media_type in {"text/html" "text/css" "text/javascript" "application/javascript" "application/json" "image/svg+xml" "application/wasm"})

http_response_compression.description: AUDENIQ JSON API prefers zstd with Brotli and gzip fallback
http_response_compression.expression: (http.host in {"studio.audeniq.com" "admin.audeniq.com" "survey.audeniq.com" "api-origin.audeniq.com"} and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/ready") and http.response.content_type.media_type in {"application/json" "application/vnd.api+json"})
